cohort: 303 placental abruption patients hospitalized and delivered in the Department of Maternity of Fujian Maternal and Child Health Hospital from January 2017 to December 2017
finding: Advanced maternal age, multigravida, irregular prenatal care, hypertensive disorder complicating pregnancy, premature rupture of membranes, fetal growth restriction, and anemia were independent risk factors for placental abruption.
